_note: Curated registry of REAL public programmes. URLs point to official pages. Criteria are INDICATIVE only; the Eligibility Verifier fetches the official page live to confirm availability and extract deadlines. Nothing here is a guarantee of eligibility.

opportunities.name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
opportunities.funding_summary: Fully funded scholarship incl. monthly stipend, travel and insurance (confirm current rates on DAAD page)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply to an eligible EPOS course, then submit the DAAD online application via the DAAD portal.

opportunities.name: DAAD Master's Scholarships Database (Study in Germany)
opportunities.funding_summary: Multiple DAAD schemes; funding varies per programme (see DAAD database)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Filter the DAAD scholarship database by country of origin, level and subject; apply per scheme.

opportunities.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM)
opportunities.funding_summary: Full-cost scholarships for selected students (tuition, travel, living allowance) - confirm per consortium
opportunities.how_to_apply: Choose a Joint Master programme from the catalogue and apply directly to its consortium.

opportunities.name: Chevening Scholarships
opportunities.funding_summary: Fully funded one-year Master's in the UK (tuition, stipend, travel)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online at chevening.org during the annual application window.

opportunities.name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
opportunities.funding_summary: Funds UK Master's study for candidates who cannot afford it (see CSC for what is covered)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply via the CSC online system, nominated through participating UK universities.

opportunities.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
opportunities.funding_summary: Full-cost scholarship at the University of Cambridge (see Trust for details)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply to Cambridge, tick the Gates Cambridge box on the application.

opportunities.name: Clarendon Scholarships (University of Oxford)
opportunities.funding_summary: Fully funded graduate scholarships at Oxford (confirm on Oxford page)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply to an Oxford graduate course by its deadline; eligible applicants are considered automatically.

opportunities.name: Rhodes Scholarship (India)
opportunities.funding_summary: Full funding at Oxford (see Rhodes Trust for coverage)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply through the Rhodes Scholarship application for India.

opportunities.name: Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowships
opportunities.funding_summary: Funding for Master's study in the US (confirm coverage with USIEF)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online through USIEF during the annual cycle.

opportunities.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
opportunities.funding_summary: Full funding for graduate study at Stanford
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply to KHS and to a Stanford graduate programme.

opportunities.name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
opportunities.funding_summary: PhD scholarship with monthly stipend and tuition (see A*STAR for current amounts)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online on the A*STAR SINGA portal.

opportunities.name: Ontario Trillium Scholarship (OTS)
opportunities.funding_summary: Funded doctoral scholarship for international students at Ontario universities
opportunities.how_to_apply: Nominated by the Ontario university you apply to for a PhD.

opportunities.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
opportunities.funding_summary: Doctoral scholarship at Canadian institutions
opportunities.how_to_apply: Nominated by a Canadian university after admission to a PhD.

opportunities.name: Vector Scholarship in Artificial Intelligence
opportunities.funding_summary: Fixed-value award for admitted students in Vector-recognised AI Master's programmes (confirm amount)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply to a recognised Ontario AI Master's programme; the university nominates candidates.

opportunities.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
opportunities.funding_summary: Research / doctoral scholarships for foreign scholars in Switzerland
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply via the Swiss university / Indian-nationals channel listed by SERI.

opportunities.name: MEXT (Japanese Government) Scholarship
opportunities.funding_summary: Government-funded study in Japan (tuition exempt, monthly allowance)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply via the Embassy of Japan in India (Embassy recommendation) or a university recommendation.

opportunities.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
opportunities.funding_summary: Government scholarship covering tuition, allowance and airfare
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply through the Korean Embassy in India or participating Korean universities.

opportunities.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
opportunities.funding_summary: Monthly allowance, travel and insurance for Master's / PhD in France (confirm on Campus France)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Your French host institution submits the application on your behalf.

opportunities.name: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship
opportunities.funding_summary: Excellence scholarship for non-EU MSc students at TU Delft (confirm coverage)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply for an MSc at TU Delft; scholarship application follows admission.

opportunities.name: Holland Scholarship
opportunities.funding_summary: One-off contribution for non-EEA students at participating Dutch institutions (confirm amount)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply via your chosen Dutch institution once admitted.

opportunities.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
opportunities.funding_summary: Full tuition and living costs for Master's studies in Sweden (see SI)
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply to a Swedish Master's programme, then to SI through its application portal.

opportunities.name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
opportunities.funding_summary: Tuition waiver, monthly stipend and accommodation support for partner-country students
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply through the Hungarian Tempus Public Foundation online system.
